name: Overqwil
description: Its lancelike spikes and savage temperament have earned it the nickname ”sea fiend.” It slurps up poison to nourish itself.

moves.name: Poison Sting
moves.description: The user stabs the target with a poisonous stinger. This may also poison the target.

moves.name: Spikes
moves.description: The user lays a trap of spikes at the target's feet. The spikes left behind by this attack continue to damage the target for several turns.

moves.name: Pin Missile
moves.description: Sharp spikes are shot at the target. Spike splinters left behind by this attack continue to damage the target for several turns.

moves.name: Barb Barrage
moves.description: The user launches countless toxic barbs to inflict damage. This may also poison the target. This move’s power is doubled if the target has a status condition.

moves.name: Water Pulse
moves.description: The user attacks the target with a pulsing blast of water. This attack never misses.

moves.name: Dark Pulse
moves.description: The user releases a horrible aura imbued with ill intent. This attack never misses.

moves.name: Poison Jab
moves.description: The target is stabbed with a tentacle, arm, or the like steeped in poison. This may also poison the target.

moves.name: Aqua Tail
moves.description: The user attacks by swinging its tail as if it were a vicious wave in a raging storm.

moves.name: Double-Edge
moves.description: A reckless, life-risking tackle in which the user rushes the target. This also damages the user.

moves.name: Self-Destruct
moves.description: The user causes an explosion to inflict damage on the target. This also damages the user.
